script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the plot was whispered or that Moabites heard it in their own city.
The text does not say there were no songs or that nobody on the road had any confidence left.
Bitter weeping does not establish that people could be heard from a long way off.
The joke mentions lunch, a food outside the permitted cookie-making terms and the passage.
The verse says Chemosh will go into exile, but does not say he is carried off.
Calling Chemosh and his priests and officials the land's protectors adds a role the text does not give them.
Comparing the destruction of every city to everyone being tagged in a group chat makes light of the devastation and does not match the action.
Moab's not having gone into exile does not establish that nothing ever shook him up.
An unchanged flavor does not establish that the wine was not sweet.
The verse says the jars will be shattered, but does not say they are not collected or carried away.
The passage does not state that Moab trusted in Chemosh. It says Moab trusted in its works and treasures.
The claim that Baal is a false god is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The verse calls them the best of Moab's young men, not its best fighters.
Calling generations 'the wrong clock' uses 'wrong' about the baker's answer.
The statement that nobody is spared goes beyond the text's statement that no town will escape.
